notes.title: HUGE UPDATE! Updates Notes :
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone!

We have heard your feedback and we made an update with a lot of bugfixes and some gameplay tweaks.

- Fixed bugs in game
- Added power ups to Foxes
- Added 4 bonus levels to collect extra apples to unlock Foxes
- Deer & Rabbit will give you 10 extra apples
- Fixed the Shop
- Minor visual fixes
- Some tweaks in game[/b]
